content.comment_body: Hello, Could you share the release date for the new firmware update for [product_name] [version_no]? We've reported multiple issues with the current firmware when connecting [product_name] [version_no] to the INSYS monitoring system. Our systems using this setup are experiencing significant instability. Thank you for your prompt assistance! Best regards, [user_name].

The firmware of a [product_name] cannot be updated. If a new firmware release becomes available for the [version_no], it is necessary to purchase a new [product_name] [version_no] module. These use the same [article_no] as previously, such as [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: A user requested a firmware update for [product_name] [version_no] due to ongoing stability problems when interfacing with the INSYS monitoring system. Another user clarified that firmware updates are not supported on this hardware; obtaining updated firmware requires purchasing new modules. This approach poses challenges for users facing compatibility or stability problems, as resolution requires hardware replacement rather than a simple firmware update.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping for firmware update support for [product_name] [version_no] hardware to address stability and compatibility issues via a software or firmware update, preferably without needing to replace existing hardware.
